{{Top|leg}}
'''Cularin Central Finance''' was an organization that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Their main office was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gadrin]], on Cularin.

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a criminal organization known as [[the Syndicate]] placed a transmitter inside Cularin Central Finance's main office, then implicated the [[Metatheran Cartel]] as being responsible for the device's presence there.
